title: Review
description: A run's hand-written review: a per-domain quality rating plus a markdown writeup. Authored separately from the machine-generated run record and required for a run to be published. The run's overall rating is the worst across its domain ratings; the run's score is the point weight of its passed checklist items over the total declared weight.

ratings.description: The reviewer's quality rating for each of the test case's declared scoring domains (see the version manifest's domains). One entry per declared domain; publishing refuses a run whose review leaves any declared domain unrated. The overall rating shown for the run is the worst across these.

writeup.description: The markdown writeup body, with any rating and checklist frontmatter stripped. Must be non-empty.

checklist.description: The reviewer's verdicts on the test case's declared reviewer checklist items (see the version manifest's reviewItems). One entry per declared item; publishing refuses a run whose review leaves any declared item without a verdict. Empty for a case that declares no items.

DomainRating.description: A reviewer's quality rating for one of the case's scoring domains.

domain.description: The declared scoring domain's stable id.

rating.description: The reviewer's verdict for this domain.

ReviewVerdict.description: A reviewer's recorded verdict on one declared checklist item.

id.description: The declared checklist item's stable id.

status.description: The verdict: pass (satisfied, earns the item's weight) or fail (not satisfied, earns none).

note.description: An optional one-line note recording what the reviewer observed.
